Definition: a species of unclean bird (from its violence), perhaps an owl
BiblicalUsage: 1) a ceremonially unclean bird; 1a) a name of the male ostrich; 1b) (CLBL) probably the great owl; 1c) perhaps an extinct bird, exact meaning unknown
